signals.definition: sum of SPY daily log returns over sessions t-251 to t-21 (12-1 month time-series momentum)
half the log of annualised SPY realised variance over sessions t-20 to t: 0.5 log((252/21) sum r^2)
variance risk premium: (VIX/100)^2/12 minus the sum of squared SPY daily log returns over sessions t-20 to t
10-year minus 3-month Treasury constant-maturity yield (FRED T10Y3M), the newest value usable at t
Moody's Baa minus Aaa corporate bond yield (FRED DBAA - DAAA), the newest values usable at t
3-month Treasury bill rate (FRED DTB3) minus its mean over the prior 252 sessions, each value as usable at its session
industrial production (ALFRED INDPRO): log change from month o-1 to o, both from the vintage usable at t
nonfarm payrolls (ALFRED PAYEMS): log change from month o-1 to o, both from the vintage usable at t
unemployment rate (ALFRED UNRATE): change from month o-1 to o, both from the vintage usable at t
CPI inflation (ALFRED CPIAUCSL): log change from month o-12 to o, both from the vintage usable at t
